shared-raw-sqrt.scope: Full81-case96-block qualification, both orders. Milliseconds are per-call medians; ratios are geometric means of paired block observations, so rounded displayed milliseconds need not divide to the paired ratio. A ratio below one is a win. Remaining reduction uses 1-1/ratio, not ratio-1. Confidence is separate.
